Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card’s effect to add a two-color Option card to my hand if one of its colors is yellow?

Card Q&A.a: No. Effects don't activate for cards revealed from your deck.
Card Q&A.q: Can this card’s effect add a card with a "this Digimon is also treated as yellow" effect to my hand?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 2-color yellow card among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
